title.zh-CN: 孕晚期咳嗽、发热和血尿 · 21岁女性
title.en: Cough, fever and haematuria in late pregnancy · woman aged 21

summary.zh-CN: 孕晚期反复呼吸与尿路症状，多次经验治疗后病程仍延续。
summary.en: Repeated respiratory and urinary symptoms persist in late pregnancy despite empirical treatments.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

reviewers: AI-assisted editorial source and guidance check; not a licensed clinician
guidelines: CDC. Tuberculosis in Pregnancy. Updated 17 April 2025. https://www.cdc.gov/tb/about/pregnancy.html

notes.zh-CN: 已对照所列权威资料进行人工智能辅助编辑核对；未由执业医师审核。原报告罕见表现及方案仍需专科确认。
notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用肺部粟粒影和尿路表现建立跨器官鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Build a cross-organ differential using miliary lung findings and urinary symptoms.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分肺部核酸确证与肾脏临床判断。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish pulmonary molecular evidence from a clinical renal diagnosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明单例终止妊娠不能成为普遍推荐。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why one delivery decision cannot become a universal recommendation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 个体化协调母胎、感染与肾脏安全，避免套用单例引产结论
learningOutcomes.en: Individualise maternal–fetal, infectious and renal safety rather than copying the delivery decision

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 孕32周加6天，咳嗽2个月、发热1个月
chiefComplaint.en: At 32 weeks and 6 days, two months of cough and one month of fever

triageNote.zh-CN: 初次妊娠，反复咳嗽发热，曾尿痛血尿，近一天不规则下腹痛。
triageNote.en: First pregnancy with recurrent cough and fever, previous painful bloody urine, and one day of irregular lower abdominal pain.

personality.zh-CN: 按当前阶段记录提供信息；交流方式为教学设定。
personality.en: Provides information from the current stage; conversational style is an educational convention.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 用日常语言叙述，检查数值由病历提供。
speechStyle.en: Uses everyday language; numerical results come from the records.

openingLine.zh-CN: 咳嗽反复2个月，发热1个月。
openingLine.en: Cough has recurred for two months and fever for one month.

fallbackUnknown.en: I am not sure about that, doctor.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 仅复述当前阶段已记录事实，不能预告后续结果。
actingNotes.en: Use only facts documented for the current phase; do not anticipate later results.

question.en: How long have cough and fever each lasted? When did cough begin, and when did fever follow?

answer.zh-CN: 咳嗽反复2个月，发热1个月。
answer.en: Cough has recurred for two months and fever for one month.

text.zh-CN: 报告经团队讨论后引产，娩出1665 g男婴，1分钟Apgar 9分。母亲转专科接受四联抗结核，病情逐渐改善后转回当地继续治疗。长期母婴和肾功能结局未给出。
text.en: After team discussion the report describes induced delivery of a 1665 g boy with one-minute Apgar 9. The mother received four-drug TB treatment and improved before transfer for continued care. Long-term maternal, infant and renal outcomes are unavailable.

hint.zh-CN: 问清主诉、进展、关联症状和关键既往史。
hint.en: Clarify presentation, progression, associated symptoms and relevant history.

hint.zh-CN: 关注哪些体征能帮助定位，并保留未记录的信息。
hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

hint.zh-CN: 将检查结果放回时间线；比较能够解释全部证据的方向。
hint.en: Place findings in their timeline and compare explanations for the complete evidence.

title.en: Plan care and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 区分已报告处置与当前教学计划，核对后续变化。
hint.en: Distinguish reported care from the educational plan and review subsequent changes.

guidance.en: Plan care and review the outcome

prompt.zh-CN: 哪种跨器官工作判断最合理？
prompt.en: Which cross-organ working interpretation is most reasonable?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 评估播散性结核及泌尿受累，同时处理肾功能恶化和产科风险
text.en: Assess disseminated tuberculosis and urinary involvement alongside renal deterioration and obstetric risk

feedback.zh-CN: 粟粒影与持续尿路异常需要统一病因评估。
feedback.en: Miliary opacities and persistent urinary abnormalities need a unifying assessment.

text.zh-CN: 普通上呼吸道感染足以解释全部表现
text.en: A simple upper respiratory infection explains everything

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释肾功能恶化、血尿和粟粒影。
feedback.en: It does not explain renal deterioration, haematuria and miliary opacities.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠生理性积水可解释所有尿异常
text.en: Physiological gestational hydronephrosis explains all urine abnormalities

feedback.zh-CN: 显著血尿、脓尿和肌酐升高需要病理性原因评估。
feedback.en: Marked haematuria, pyuria and creatinine elevation need pathological assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 肺部有核酸支持，肾部诊断证据较间接
text.en: Pulmonary disease has molecular support; renal evidence is more indirect

feedback.zh-CN: 肺病原阳性不能自动变成肾组织确证。
feedback.en: Positive pulmonary testing is not renal histological confirmation.

text.zh-CN: 涂片阴性排除结核
text.en: Negative smears exclude tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性涂片不能推翻已阳性的核酸和临床证据。
feedback.en: Negative smears do not negate positive molecular and clinical findings.

text.zh-CN: 可确定所有肾损伤均由结核造成
text.en: All renal injury is proven to be caused by tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 梗阻、病原和其他可能因素尚缺充分区分。
feedback.en: Obstruction, infection and other contributors are not fully distinguished.

prompt.zh-CN: 母胎及肾脏风险应如何协调？
prompt.en: How should maternal, fetal and renal risks be coordinated?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 产科、结核与肾脏团队制定治疗和分娩计划，并复核肾功能对用药的影响
text.en: Obstetric, TB and renal teams should individualise treatment and delivery plans, including renal effects on medicines

feedback.zh-CN: 历史引产是本例处置，不代表所有妊娠结核均需终止。
feedback.en: The reported induction is case-specific and does not mean every pregnancy with TB requires termination.

text.zh-CN: 只要妊娠合并结核就必须立即终止妊娠
text.en: All pregnancies with TB must be terminated immediately

feedback.zh-CN: 不能从单例推导普遍产科指征。
feedback.en: A single report cannot establish a universal obstetric indication.

text.zh-CN: 分娩前无需处理活动性感染
text.en: Active infection need not be addressed before delivery

feedback.zh-CN: 母体疾病和器官风险需要及时专业处理。
feedback.en: Maternal disease and organ risk require timely specialist attention.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 个体化协调母胎、感染与肾脏安全，避免套用单例引产结论
text.en: Individualise maternal–fetal, infectious and renal safety rather than copying the delivery decision

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：用肺部粟粒影和尿路表现建立跨器官鉴别。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：尿结核培养、药敏、长期肾功能、完整新生儿结核评估及母婴随访。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Build a cross-organ differential using miliary lung findings and urinary symptoms. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Urinary mycobacterial culture, susceptibility, long-term renal function, full neonatal TB evaluation and maternal–infant follow-up. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告为妊娠合并粟粒性肺结核及临床肾结核，肺部核酸阳性而肾部确证有限。
conclusion.en: The report describes pregnancy with miliary pulmonary TB and clinically diagnosed renal TB; pulmonary molecular evidence is positive but renal confirmation is limited.

teachingPoints.en: Explain why one delivery decision cannot become a universal recommendation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尿结核培养、药敏、长期肾功能、完整新生儿结核评估及母婴随访。
unknowns.en: Urinary mycobacterial culture, susceptibility, long-term renal function, full neonatal TB evaluation and maternal–infant follow-up.

testUtterances.text: 咳嗽和发热各持续多久了？
How long have cough and fever each lasted?
最早什么时候开始咳嗽，后来什么时候发烧？
When did cough begin, and when did fever follow?
排尿会痛吗，尿里有没有血？
Is urination painful, and is there blood in the urine?
有没有尿频、血块或腰痛？
Have there been frequency, clots or back pain?
现在怀孕几周，之前怀过孕吗？
How many weeks pregnant are you, and have you been pregnant before?
这是第几次妊娠？
Is this your first pregnancy or have there been earlier pregnancies?
肚子哪里痛，什么时候开始的？
Where does the abdomen hurt, and when did it begin?
腹痛是一阵阵的还是一直痛？
Is abdominal pain intermittent or constant?
最高烧到多少度？
What was the highest temperature?
这次发热有多高？
How high has the fever been?
来院前用过哪些药？
Which medicines were used before admission?
之前的药名和用药时间知道吗？
Are earlier drug names and timing known?
出院后症状什么时候又出现？
When did symptoms return after discharge?
回家后有没有再次咳嗽？
Did coughing recur after returning home?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
